analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($367.81/$385.94): mid/long-term trend strength advantage.
· 52-week position (54.6%) + current price level at historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (60.1→65.5) + entering overbought, maintaining upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.8746→2.5961) + bullish expansion, strengthening uptrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $399.31) + breaking upper band, bullish expansion phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($393.63) + high position relative to 20-day low ($345.88).
· Swing resistance ($409.28) + potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + confirmation of continued uptrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.02x vs 5-day average) + normal level, maintaining confidence in movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + additional buy entry condition upon breaking $409.28.
